title: typos fails repo-wide on false positives and the vendored proto
description:
Found during the HIRE rename. 'typos .' exits 2 with 17 findings, and all 16 remaining ones are things that must NOT be changed:

- 13x 'fpr' in hire-attestors/src/gpg.rs. That is gpg's own --with-colons field name for a fingerprint, not a misspelling of 'for'. Same class as the spaced-hex false positive already recorded in Mark's workflow notes.
- 3x in proto/spiffe/workload/workload.proto ('Reponse' twice, 'succesfully'). That file is VENDORED upstream SPIFFE. Byte-identical vendoring is the point; fixing upstream's typos locally would make the vendored copy diverge and is wrong.

The one finding that was genuinely ours ('unparseable' in hire-nmh, introduced earlier the same day) is fixed in 4f245c8.

typos is not CI-gated -- ci.yml has check/portability/msrv/audit and no typos job -- so this is only felt by whoever runs it locally from the pre-push checklist, where it is currently useless because it always exits 2.

Fix: add .typos.toml with extend-words for 'fpr' and files.extend-exclude for proto/. Then typos exit 0 means something again. Do NOT fix the proto.
